title: Smaller Than Expected
text: Smaller Than Expected. I needed to use a shower curtain to close off a hallway for privacy needs. I had a rod but it was too long for the hall so I found this. The pictures gave nothing for scale. The length was in the range I needed and the price was right so I ordered it. The rod is seriously thin. That being said I have a full width, single piece, curtain hung from it and it's stayed in place for a while now. My old shower rod was fully an inch across, this is half or less of that. It worried me but I even brush past/through this curtain several times a day and so far so good. Does what's needed.
